messages.content:
A mod for Starsector that allows the player to remove s-mods or to increase the max s-mod limit of a ship.

**Requirements:** 
- Lunalib
**Compatibility:** 
- Should be compatible with most mods
- Not safe to remove from an ongoing campaign
- Not save compatible with versions below 1.0.0

For mod changes check out the changelog link.

**Download:** https://github.com/AudaxLudos/adjustable-s-mods/releases/download/1.1.2/AdjustableSMods-1.1.2.zip
**Changelog:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AudaxLudos/adjustable-s-mods/main/CHANGELOG.txt
**Old Versions:** https://github.com/AudaxLudos/adjustable-s-mods/releases
